\node[card] (a) {\heading{1}{通常Calabi--Yau型から単純モデルへ}{From ordinary Calabi--Yau type to a simple model}

$\mathcal L=K_X+N_0,\quad c_1(H)\leq k c_1(\mathcal L)\ (H\to\Omega_X^{\otimes k})$\\
\Tx{点blowupにも同じ傾きの評価を課す。}{The corresponding slope bound also holds after a point blowup.}};
\flow a b {\Tx{nef b-partを0として積分解し、単純モデルへ帰着}{Apply the product decomposition with zero nef b-part; reduce to a simple model}\\\Cite{external-bby}\quad\Cite{reduction}};
\node[card,below=2.0cm of b] (c) {\heading{3}{有理型切断から符号付き因子表示へ}{From a meromorphic section to a signed divisor}
$\mathcal L^{\otimes m}\text{ has a meromorphic section},\quad N_0\sim_{\mathbb Q}E-G$\\
$E,G\geq0,\quad K'+uE,\ K'+uG\text{ ordinary klt adjoints}$};
\flow b c {\Tx{二つの対角線：行列式の消滅と点極の上界が衝突}{Two diagonals: determinant vanishing contradicts the point-pole bound}\\\Cite{nonvanishing}\quad\Cite{cancellation}};
\node[result,below=2.0cm of c] (d) {\heading{4}{両符号のpseudo-effectivityから消滅}{Both signs are pseudo-effective, hence the class vanishes}
$N(\alpha_E)\leq N(\alpha_G),\quad u\{N_0\}=\{N(\alpha_E)-N(\alpha_G)\}$\\
$\{N_0\}\text{ nef},\ -\{N_0\}\text{ pseudo-effective}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad c_1(M)=0$};
\flow c d {\Tx{代数次元0で通常分解の正部分は有理自明；負部分を比較}{Ordinary positive parts are rationally trivial in algebraic dimension zero; compare negatives}\\\Cite{ordinary}\quad\Cite{zero-simple}};
